_doc: M4 towers (PLAN M4). Each row is the fighting part of a buildings.json row of the same id (that row holds size, cost, look, sight, tag `military`). `range` in cells (0.5 m), `cooldown` in ticks between shots (20 a second), `damage` per hit, `shot`: bolt (a projectile that flies at `speed` cells a second and hits one enemy), burst (instant rounds with tracers: `rounds` hits at `spacing` ticks), shell (a mortar round that lands after `flight` ticks where the target was and bursts with radius `splash`, breaking the ground with a blast of `blast` [radius, power]). `minRange` = too close to aim at. `nests: true` = it shoots a nest in range when there is no enemy to shoot. Every shot needs the target on LIVE sight (fog 2). Own shots pass over own walls. `noise` is what one shot adds to the Noise field (gunfire is loud). Global level per kind (upgrades.json `tower.<id>`): each level above I multiplies damage by `perLevel.damage`, range by `perLevel.range` and hit points by `perLevel.hp`.

list.name: Watch post
list.about: A lamp and a lookout with a crossbow. Sees far and lights the dark around it.

list.name: Bolt thrower
list.about: A heavy crossbow on a turntable. One big hit at a time, a long way out.

list.name: Gun nest
list.about: Sandbags and a rattling gun. Shreds a swarm up close. Loud.

list.name: Mortar pit
list.about: Lobs shells over your own walls. Breaks the ground and sets it alight where they land.
